description: This file defines Express.js routes for handling insurance claim operations, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claims, with integrations for fraud scoring.

methods.name: list claims
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all claims.

methods.name: create claim
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new claim, applies fraud scoring, and stores the claim.

methods.name: get claim by id
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific claim by its ID.

methods.name: update claim
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing claim and re-apply fraud scoring.

methods.name: delete claim
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a claim by its ID.
